layoutZones = {}

function hideMarkers(side, tag)
	local objs
	local allPpl = Player.getAvailableColors()
	if side == 'left' or side == 'both' then
		objs = findObject('leftPlayerZone').getObjects()
		hideFrom(objs, tag, allPpl)
	end
	if side == 'right' or side == 'both' then
		objs = findObject('rightPlayerZone').getObjects()
		hideFrom(objs, tag, allPpl)
	end
end

function hideFrom(objs, tag, ppl)
	for _, obj in ipairs(objs) do
		if obj.hasTag(tag) then obj.setInvisibleTo(ppl) end
	end
end

function revealMarkers(side, tag)
	local objs
	if side == 'left' then
		objs = findObject('leftPlayerZone').getObjects()
		reveal(objs, tag)
	end
	if side == 'right' then
		objs = findObject('rightPlayerZone').getObjects()
		reveal(objs, tag)
	end
end

function reveal(objs, tag)
	local version = getVersion()
	for _, obj in ipairs(objs) do
		if obj.hasTag(tag) then
			if not (version:sub(1, 5) ~= 'Agora' and obj.hasTag('agora')) then obj.setInvisibleTo() end
		end
	end
end

function toggleLayoutZones(button)
	local side
	if button.guid == guidLookup.left_toggleLayoutButton then side = 'left' else side = 'right' end
	--if in_zone.guid == guidLookup.leftPlayerZone then side = 'left' else side = 'right' end
	local lz = areThereLayoutZones(false, side, false)
	local markerTag = 'color card'
	if lz then
		-- "hide" layout zones
		layoutZones[side] = saveLayoutZones(lz)
		for _, layoutZone in ipairs(lz) do
			layoutZone.destruct()
		end
		-- hide markers
		hideMarkers(side, markerTag)		-- no need to handle the agora case(s)
	else
		-- reveal layout zones
		restoreLayoutZones(layoutZones[side], true)
		-- reveal markers
		revealMarkers(side, markerTag)		-- will handle the agora case(s)
	end
end

areThereLayoutZones = function(name, note, tag)
	local allObjs = Global.getObjects()
	local someLayoutZones = {}
	for _, obj in ipairs(allObjs) do
		local add = false
		if obj.type == 'Layout' then
			-- doing this with the if layed out that away allow multiple criteria (name/note/tag) to be handled (not just 1)
			add = true
			if name then
				if obj.getName() == name then add = true else add = false end
			end
			if note then
				if obj.getGMNotes() == note then add = true else add = false end
			end
			if tag then add = obj.hasTag(tag) end
			if add then table.insert(someLayoutZones, obj) end
		end
	end
	if not not next(someLayoutZones) then return someLayoutZones else return nil end
end

restoreLayoutZones = function(layoutZones, layoutAction)
	layoutAction = layoutAction or false
	--for _, layoutZone in ipairs(zl.savedVar.layoutZones[side]) do
	for _, layoutZone in ipairs(layoutZones) do
		local spawnedLZ = spawnObject({
			type = layoutZone.type,
			sound = layoutZone.sound,
			position = layoutZone.position,
			rotation = layoutZone.rotation,
			scale = layoutZone.scale,
		})
		spawnedLZ.setName(layoutZone.name)
		spawnedLZ.setDescription(layoutZone.descr)
		spawnedLZ.setGMNotes(layoutZone.notes)
		spawnedLZ.setTags(layoutZone.tags)
		spawnedLZ.LayoutZone.setOptions(layoutZone.LayoutZoneOptions)
		NAMEdb[layoutZone.name] = spawnedLZ.guid	-- update NAMEdb since the new layout zone re-created has a new GUID
		if layoutAction then Wait.time(function() spawnedLZ.LayoutZone.layout() end, 0.1) end
	end
	--broadcastToColor('Layout zones ' .. zl.bbCode('enabled', Color.Green) .. '.', playerColor)
	return true
end

function indexObjects(object)
	local allObj = {}
	if not object then
		NAMEdb = {}
		NOTEdb = {}
		allObj = Global.getObjects()
	else
		table.insert(allObj, object)
	end

	for _, obj in ipairs(allObj) do
		indexName(obj)
		indexNote(obj)
	end
end

function indexName(obj)
	local name = obj.getName()
	if name ~= '' and not NAMEdb[name] then
		NAMEdb[name] = obj.getGUID()
	end
end

function indexNote(obj)
	local note = obj.getGMNotes()
	if note ~= '' and not NOTEdb[note] then
		NOTEdb[note] = obj.getGUID()
	end
end

function getObjectFromName(name)
	if type(name) == 'string' then
		if NAMEdb[name] then return getObjectFromGUID(NAMEdb[name]) end
	end
	return nil
end

function getObjectFromGMNotes(note)
	if type(note) == 'string' then
		if NOTEdb[note] then return getObjectFromGUID(NOTEdb[note]) end
	end
	return nil
end

function toggleLZoptions(button)
	local buttonNote = button.getGMNotes()
	local lz = getObjectFromName(buttonNote .. ' LZ')
	local lzOptions = lz.LayoutZone.getOptions()
	if lzOptions.meld_sort == 1 then	-- = sort by Added Time
		-- switch to sort by GMNotes, reverse (= descending)
		lz.LayoutZone.setOptions({meld_sort = 5, meld_reverse_sort = true})
	else
		-- switch to sort by Added Time, no reverse (= ascending)
		lz.LayoutZone.setOptions({meld_sort = 1, meld_reverse_sort = false})
	end
	Wait.time(function() lz.LayoutZone.layout() end, 0.1)
end

function onPlayerAction(player, action, targets)
	-- perfect flip (with proper rotation) for the 'Spice Reserve' token
	-- 2 rotation values defined via the Gizmo tool 'No' and 1
	if action == Player.Action.FlipOver and targets[1].hasTag('rotate flip') then
		for i = 1, #targets do
			-- [method 1]: without setting rotation values, via setRotation()...
			--targets[1].setRotation(targets[1].getRotation() + vector(0, 0, 180))
			-- [method 2]: slower alternative, via setRotationSmooth()
			targets[i].setRotationSmooth(targets[i].getRotation() + vector(0, 0, -180), false, false)
			-- [method 3]:
			-- cleaner alternative (but requires to set rotation values before), via getRotationValue()/setRotationValue()
			-- the one that look and feel most like a real flip
			--if targets[1].getRotationValue() == 'No' then
			--	targets[1].setRotationValue(1)
			--elseif targets[1].getRotationValue() == 1 then
			--	targets[1].setRotationValue('No')
			--end
		end
		return false	-- prevent the flip performed by the player (done just above via script and setRotation())
	end
	return true			-- any other object can perform the regular flip
end

function calcRotation(params)
  local position    = params.newPos
  local origin_pos  = params.originPos
  local angle       = params.rotAngle

  local flat_origin = origin_pos:copy():setAt('y', 0)
  return (position - flat_origin):rotateOver('y', angle) + flat_origin
end

    local random = math.random

        local randomIndex = offset*random()
        local flooredIndex = randomIndex - randomIndex%1

        if flooredIndex == offset then

        end
